text: {"findings":[{"rule_id":"MF-005","evidence":[{"kind":"note","ref":"N3","page":1,"quote":"HEAT TREATMENT :- 1) TO BE TOUGHENED UPTO 24-32 HRC. 2) RETAPPING TO BE DONE AFTER SURFACE TREATMENT AT SUPPLIER END.( IF APPLICABLE )"}],"comment":"The heat treatment note specifies the hardness range but does not state at which manufacturing stage it applies (e.g., before or after machining, before plating). Without this sequence the supplier cannot plan the process correctly, risking distortion of finished features or damage to the coating. The designer should add the required stage to the heat treatment instruction in N3.","recommended_correction":"Update N3 to specify when toughening is performed relative to machining and surface treatment (for example, 'TO BE TOUGHENED TO 24-32 HRC AFTER ROUGH MACHINING AND BEFORE FINAL MACHINING AND PLATING')."},{"rule_id":"TL-002","evidence":[{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D11","page":1,"quote":"30"},{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D12","page":1,"quote":"20"},{"kind":"note","ref":"N10","page":1,"quote":"NOTE FOR WIPRO PARI DESIGN -REF. ONLY WEAR DETAILS : MW"}],"comment":"Dimensions D11 (Ø30) and D12 (Ø20) define the diameters of a part titled 'SUPPORT BUSH' with a wear-related note (N10), yet neither carries a fit designation or tolerance callout. Untoleranced mating diameters on a bush leave the fit undefined, so the assembler cannot guarantee proper function. The designer should add appropriate ISO fit tolerances or explicit limits to D11 and D12.","recommended_correction":"Add fit or tolerance callouts to D11 and D12 (e.g., Ø30H7, Ø20h6) suitable for the bush's mating features."}]}
